_comment: Version-controlled NavDP TensorRT build + gate policy. JSON (not YAML) because the repo .gitignore globs *.yaml. Tunables read by engine/inspect_onnx.py and benchmark/bench.py.
_strongly_typed_note: TensorRT >=11 removed weak typing, so FP16 is forced via an FP16 ONNX. The deep DINOv2 ViT encoder drifts badly when its 24-block residual stream is stored+accumulated in FP16 (no per-layer fallback like TRT-10). So on the strongly-typed path these engines are built FP32; on TRT-10 (the Orin) weak typing handles all three in mixed FP16 and this list is ignored.
